metadata.title: W3C Verifiable Credentials Adversarial & Negative Test Register

fixtures.mutationDetails: Flipped single byte in credentialSubject.trade claim ('Carpentry' -> 'Master Carpenter')
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Prevents unauthorized elevation of artisan skills or claims

fixtures.mutationDetails: Replaced valid 64-byte Ed25519 signature in jws/proofValue with random bytes
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Blocks forged credentials from untrusted sources
Ensures only certified platform and institutional issuers are accepted

fixtures.mutationDetails: Set expirationDate to 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z (past date relative to current 2026 period)
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Enforces mandatory periodic re-attestation of safety and trade certifications

fixtures.mutationDetails: Set credentialStatus.statusPurpose to 'revocation' with bit index marked 1 in BitstringStatusList
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Instantly terminates trust upon safety violations or worker deregistrations

fixtures.mutationDetails: Credential marked as temporarily suspended pending dispute investigation
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Safely freezes dispatch eligibility during ongoing ombudsperson investigations

fixtures.testName: Unknown Key Version (Key Not in DID Document)
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Prevents rogue keys from signing valid-looking credentials

fixtures.testName: Retired Signing Key Usage for New Credential
fixtures.mutationDetails: verificationMethod points to retired key 'did:web:kaamsetu.org#key-2025-v1' past retirementDate
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Enforces cryptographic key lifecycle and deprecation of older rotation keys

fixtures.mutationDetails: Holder DID does not match credentialSubject.id in Verifiable Presentation wrapper
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Prevents credential theft and impersonation by third-party individuals

fixtures.testName: Withdrawn Consent Flag in Status Registry
fixtures.mutationDetails: Worker revoked consent for external profile discovery via consent_audit_events
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Guarantees worker sovereignty over identity publication

fixtures.mutationDetails: Unsorted keys, varying whitespace, and unescaped Unicode characters in canonical payload
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Prevents semantic ambiguity across heterogeneous JSON parsers

fixtures.mutationDetails: Presentation of already recorded credential ID with altered issuance context
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Blocks double-spending of single-use job completion attestations

fixtures.testName: Signature Algorithm Substitution (Downgrade to none or RSA-MD5)
fixtures.mutationDetails: Proof type replaced with 'none' or insecure legacy digest algorithm
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Stops algorithmic downgrade attacks against verification engines

fixtures.testName: Cross-Environment Key Substitution (Staging Key in Production)
fixtures.mutationDetails: Credential signed with staging environment private key presented to production API
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Prevents staging test tokens from gaining production access

fixtures.testName: Incorrect Issuer URL / Scheme (HTTP instead of HTTPS)
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Prevents MITM tampering of DID documents and public keys

fixtures.mutationDetails: Base64URL compressed QR payload truncated by 30% representing physical QR damage
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Ensures damaged or partially scanned QR codes fail safely without parsing garbage

fixtures.testName: Replay of Revoked Credential via Offline Cache
fixtures.mutationDetails: Presenting cached credential that was revoked online within 24-hour verification window
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Forces periodic online sync for high-stakes enterprise dispatches

fixtures.testName: Stale Offline Verification Data (Cache Expiration Exceeded)
fixtures.mutationDetails: Offline verification attempted where status list freshness exceeds MAX_OFFLINE_CACHE_HOURS (72h)
fixtures.interoperabilityImpact: Blocks indefinite air-gapped usage of revoked credentials
